leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a frequency map to represent character counts in a target anagram
Initialize a sliding window to traverse the input string efficiently
Manipulate window boundaries to maintain the correct substring length
Update character frequency counts dynamically as the window slides
Integrate comparison logic to detect when a substring matches the anagram pattern
Configure result storage to collect starting indices of valid anagrams
Implement the complete algorithm to find all anagram occurrences in a string
lessonTitle: Find All Anagrams in a String
